PrivacyPolicyPage.title: Privacy Policy
PrivacyPolicyPage.subtitle: How Omnider collects, uses, stores, and protects your information across our web platform, mobile applications, and integrated messaging channels.
intro: This Privacy Policy ("Policy") describes how Omnider ("Omnider", "we", "us", or "our") collects, uses, discloses, and safeguards personal information when you use our products and services, including the Omnider Web Platform, the Omnider Android application (available on Google Play), the Omnider iOS application (available on the Apple App Store), and all related integrations, APIs, dashboards, and support services (collectively, the "Services").
By accessing or using the Services, you acknowledge that you have read and understood this Policy. If you do not agree with our practices, please do not use the Services.

sections.title: Scope of This Policy
paragraphs: This Policy applies to all Omnider products and services, including:
list: Omnider Web Platform and related web properties
Omnider Android Application (Google Play)
Omnider iOS Application (Apple App Store)
Customer Panel at https://app.omnider.com

subsections.title: Messaging Channels and Integrations
paragraphs: The Services enable you to connect and manage conversations and interactions across supported messaging, email, SMS, voice, review/comment, and business channels, including without limitation:
list: WhatsApp Business Platform and WhatsApp Personal connections
Instagram (Direct Messaging, story replies, and post comments)
Facebook Messenger
Telegram
LINE
Web Chat
Email (business mailboxes and supported email providers)
SMS
Phone / voice call integrations
Google Business Profile (reviews and ratings)
Google Chat
LinkedIn
Other official platforms and integrations that Omnider may add in the future

sections.title: Information We Collect
paragraphs: We collect information in three general categories: information you provide, information generated through your use of the Services, and information received from third-party platforms you connect.

subsections.title: Account and Profile Information
list: Name, email address, phone number, company name, and billing details
Login credentials and authentication data
Team member profiles, roles, and permissions
Partner account details and referral information

subsections.title: Messaging and Customer Data
list: Message, email, SMS, and voice interaction content; timestamps, delivery status, and conversation metadata
Contact names, phone numbers, email addresses, usernames, profile identifiers, and channel-specific IDs
Instagram post comments, Google Business reviews/replies, and similar public interaction data
Tags, notes, assignments, and workflow states applied within the shared inbox
Campaign audience data, templates, and broadcast history

subsections.title: Files and Media
list: Images, videos, audio messages, documents, and attachments exchanged through connected channels
Files uploaded to knowledge bases, chatbot flows, or AI training contexts
Metadata associated with uploaded or processed media (file type, size, timestamps)

subsections.title: Technical and Usage Information
list: IP address, browser type, device type, operating system, and app version
Log records, session identifiers, and feature usage events
Cookie and similar technology data as described below
Crash reports and performance diagnostics from mobile applications

subsections.title: Payment Information
paragraphs: Subscription and payment processing are handled by third-party payment providers. We receive billing status, transaction references, and limited payment metadata, but we do not store full payment card numbers on our servers.

subsections.title: Google Workspace Integration Data
paragraphs: If you authorize Google Workspace integrations (such as Google Sheets, Google Drive, or Google Calendar), we may process data necessary to perform the synchronization, export, backup, or calendar-management actions you request. Google Workspace API data is processed only within those authorized integration workflows and is kept separate from AI-powered messaging features, as described in the Google API Services and Limited Use section below.

Google Business Profile reviews/ratings and Google Chat messages are processed as separate channels from Google Workspace (Sheets/Drive/Calendar) integrations; content from those channels is covered under Messaging and Customer Data above.

sections.title: How We Use Your Information
paragraphs: We use collected information to operate, maintain, and improve the Services, including to:
list: Create and manage user accounts across the Customer Panel and Partner Panel
Deliver, route, store, and synchronize messages across connected channels
Provide shared inbox, automation, campaign, appointment, and team management features
Perform user-authorized Google Sheets, Google Drive, and Google Calendar synchronization, export, backup, and record-management operations
Authenticate users and enforce access controls
Process subscriptions, invoices, and account-related communications
Provide customer support, onboarding, and technical assistance
Monitor service performance, detect abuse, and maintain platform security
Comply with legal obligations and enforce our Terms of Use

sections.title: Use of AI Services
paragraphs: Omnider offers AI-powered features such as automated replies, knowledge-base responses, document understanding, image analysis, video analysis, and voice message processing. AI-powered messaging and Google Workspace integrations are separate functions and operate as separate workflows. When you enable AI features:
list: Relevant message content, prompts, and contextual data may be transmitted to AI service providers strictly to generate responses or perform the requested analysis
AI outputs are generated based on the information you provide and your configured settings; you remain responsible for reviewing AI-generated content before sending it to end customers
We implement contractual and technical safeguards with AI providers to limit data use to service delivery purposes
You may disable or configure AI features within your account settings where available
Google Workspace API data (raw, aggregated, anonymized, or derived) is not included in AI prompts, chatbot conversations, or transfers to AI/ML providers

subsections.title: AI Data Minimization
paragraphs: We strive to send only the minimum data necessary to perform the requested AI function. We do not use your private messaging data to train public AI models unless you have explicitly opted in to a feature that clearly states otherwise. Google Workspace API data is never used to develop, train, fine-tune, test, or improve AI or machine learning models.

subsections.title: AI Service Providers
paragraphs: Omnider may use OpenRouter, and third-party models accessible through OpenRouter, to power AI-assisted customer messaging. Only relevant messaging content and chatbot instructions configured by the business may be sent to OpenRouter for that purpose.

Google Workspace API data is not included in any data transfer to OpenRouter or to any other third-party AI/ML service. The underlying models and providers used may vary based on your customer or business configuration; however, Google Workspace data is not routed to any model.

sections.title: Google API Services and Limited Use
paragraphs: Omnider’s use and transfer of information received from Google APIs adheres to the Google API Services User Data Policy, including the Limited Use requirements.

Google Sheets, Google Drive, and Google Calendar integrations are used only for synchronization, export, backup, and record-management operations that you expressly authorize. Example workflows include adding or updating a new Omnider CRM customer record in a Google Sheet you select; creating or updating an Omnider appointment in your Google Calendar; and exporting or backing up Omnider data to your Google Drive account.

Google connections are used only after you expressly grant permission through Google OAuth. Access is limited to the scopes and duration necessary to perform the functionality you request. You may disconnect a Google integration at any time; upon disconnection, future API access and synchronization operations are stopped.
Where data must be read from Google for synchronization, that data is used only within the relevant CRM or integration workflow. It is not transferred to an AI service or AI model.
list: Raw or derived Google Workspace API data is not used to develop, train, fine-tune, test, or improve generalized or foundational artificial intelligence or machine learning models.
Google Workspace API data is not transferred to OpenRouter or any other third-party AI/ML service.
Google Workspace API data is not included in AI prompts or chatbot conversations.
Google integrations and AI-powered messaging operate as separate workflows.
Google data is used only for user-authorized synchronization, export, backup, and calendar-management features.
Where Google data is retrieved for synchronization, it remains within the integration workflow and is not routed to an AI provider.
Google user data is not sold, is not used for advertising, and is not shared with unrelated third parties.
Google user data is processed only to provide the Services, maintain security, comply with legal obligations, or perform integration operations you expressly request.

sections.title: File and Media Processing
paragraphs: Files and media transmitted through Omnider may be temporarily stored, scanned, transcoded, or analyzed to enable inbox display, automation, AI features, backups, and compliance workflows. Processing may include:
list: Storing attachments in secure cloud infrastructure
Generating previews, transcripts, or extracted text for AI and search features
Applying virus and malware scanning where technically feasible
Retaining media according to your account settings and applicable retention rules

subsections.title: Your Responsibilities
paragraphs: You are responsible for ensuring that you have the legal right to collect, store, and process files and media belonging to your customers or contacts. Do not upload unlawful, infringing, or sensitive content without appropriate legal basis and safeguards.

sections.title: Cookies and Similar Technologies
paragraphs: Our websites and web applications use cookies, local storage, pixels, and similar technologies to:
list: Maintain sessions and remember language or interface preferences
Measure traffic, campaign performance, and product usage
Support security, fraud prevention, and authentication
Enable analytics and advertising measurement integrations where applicable

subsections.title: Managing Cookies
paragraphs: You can control cookies through your browser settings. Disabling certain cookies may limit functionality of the Customer Panel, Partner Panel, or marketing website. Mobile applications may use equivalent on-device storage mechanisms for similar purposes.

sections.title: Log Records
paragraphs: We maintain server, application, API, and security logs that may include IP addresses, request timestamps, endpoint paths, user agents, error traces, and administrative actions. Logs are used for troubleshooting, auditing, abuse detection, capacity planning, and legal compliance.

Access to logs is restricted to authorized personnel and service providers under confidentiality obligations. Log retention periods vary by log type and operational need, as described in the Data Retention section below.

sections.title: Security
paragraphs: We implement administrative, technical, and organizational measures designed to protect personal information, including encryption in transit, access controls, role-based permissions, monitoring, and secure development practices.

No method of transmission or storage is completely secure. While we work continuously to protect your data, we cannot guarantee absolute security. You are responsible for safeguarding your account credentials and promptly notifying us of any suspected unauthorized access.

sections.title: Data Retention
paragraphs: We retain personal information for as long as necessary to provide the Services, fulfill the purposes described in this Policy, comply with legal obligations, resolve disputes, and enforce agreements.

Retention periods may vary based on account status, subscription plan, feature usage, legal requirements, and your deletion requests. When data is no longer required, we delete or anonymize it in accordance with our internal retention schedules, subject to backup and legal hold exceptions.

sections.title: Your Privacy Rights
paragraphs: Depending on your location, you may have rights to access, correct, delete, restrict, object to, or port certain personal information. You may also withdraw consent where processing is consent-based.

To exercise applicable rights, contact us using the details at the end of this Policy. We may need to verify your identity before responding. We will respond within the timeframes required by applicable law.

sections.title: Account Deletion / Data Deletion Request
paragraphs: You may request deletion of your Omnider account and associated personal data at any time. To submit a verified account or data deletion request, visit our dedicated page at /en/delete-account for full instructions, required information, and processing timelines.
You may also send your request by email to info@omnider.com from your registered account email address. Upon verified account deletion:
list: Access to the Customer Panel or Partner Panel will be disabled
Active subscriptions will be terminated according to our billing terms
Associated workspace data will be scheduled for deletion subject to legal and operational retention requirements
Connected third-party integrations may require separate disconnection on the respective platform

subsections.title: Partial Data Deletion
paragraphs: If you need to delete specific personal information without closing your entire account, follow the same process on the /en/delete-account page. Please note that deleting certain data may prevent us from providing all or part of the Services. Data controlled by third-party platforms must often be deleted directly through those platforms or their official tools, in addition to any request made to Omnider.

sections.title: KVKK Compliance (Turkey)
paragraphs: If you are located in Turkey or your data is processed under Turkish law, Omnider processes personal data in accordance with Law No. 6698 on the Protection of Personal Data ("KVKK").

Depending on the circumstances, Omnider may act as a data controller for account and billing data, and as a data processor for customer messaging data that you upload or synchronize through the Services. Where Omnider acts as a processor, you remain responsible for establishing a lawful basis for processing your end customers' data.
list: You may request information about whether your personal data is being processed
You may request correction of incomplete or inaccurate data
You may request deletion or destruction of data under KVKK conditions
You may object to processing and request compensation for damages arising from unlawful processing, as provided by law

subsections.title: KVKK Applications
paragraphs: KVKK-related requests may be submitted to info@omnider.com. We will respond within the statutory period after verifying your identity.

sections.title: GDPR Compliance (European Union / EEA / UK)
paragraphs: If you are in the European Union, European Economic Area, or United Kingdom, Omnider processes personal data in accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation ("GDPR") and applicable local implementations.
list: Lawful bases may include contract performance, legitimate interests, legal obligation, and consent where required
You have the right of access, rectification, erasure, restriction, portability, and objection
You may lodge a complaint with your local supervisory authority
Where data is transferred outside the EEA/UK, we rely on appropriate safeguards such as standard contractual clauses or equivalent mechanisms where applicable

sections.title: Google Play Developer Policy Compliance
paragraphs: The Omnider Android application is distributed through Google Play and is designed to comply with Google Play Developer Program Policies, including requirements relating to user data, permissions, prominent disclosure, and secure handling of sensitive information.

We limit Android permissions to what is necessary for app functionality, provide clear in-app disclosures where required, and maintain this Policy in a publicly accessible location for Google Play review and user reference.

sections.title: Apple App Store Review Guidelines Compliance
paragraphs: The Omnider iOS application is distributed through the Apple App Store and is designed to comply with Apple App Store Review Guidelines, including privacy, data collection disclosure, account deletion, and user transparency requirements.
Where required by Apple, we provide accurate privacy nutrition labels and in-app explanations of data use. Users can request account deletion as described in this Policy.

sections.title: Meta Platform Terms Compliance
paragraphs: When you connect WhatsApp Business Platform, Instagram Business Messaging, or Facebook Messenger through Omnider, you must comply with Meta Platform Terms, Developer Policies, Commerce Policies, and all applicable Meta product terms.

Omnider accesses Meta platform data only as authorized by you and solely to provide the Services you configure. You are responsible for obtaining any required consents from your customers and for using Meta APIs in compliance with Meta's rules.

sections.title: WhatsApp Personal Integration

warning.title: Important Notice Regarding WhatsApp Personal
paragraphs: Connecting a personal WhatsApp account to Omnider via QR code is not an officially supported method endorsed by Meta. This integration is provided solely at the user's own request and discretion.
list: Account restrictions or limitations imposed by WhatsApp or Meta
Phone number blocking or loss of messaging capability
Temporary or permanent bans from WhatsApp
Data loss, message loss, or synchronization failures
Service interruptions or degraded functionality

paragraphs: All risks and liabilities arising from use of the WhatsApp Personal integration remain solely with you. Omnider provides no warranty, guarantee, or assurance regarding the availability, stability, or continued operation of this integration.
Omnider strongly recommends using the official WhatsApp Business Platform wherever possible for professional, compliant, and reliable customer communication.

sections.title: Third-Party Messaging Platforms and APIs
paragraphs: Use of the following services through Omnider is also subject to the respective platform's own terms, policies, and developer rules:
list: WhatsApp Business Platform
Instagram Business
Facebook Messenger
Telegram
LINE

subsections.title: Policy Changes by Third Parties
paragraphs: Omnider is not responsible for changes to third-party platform policies, API restrictions, pricing, outages, enforcement actions, or account suspensions imposed by those platforms. You are responsible for monitoring and complying with each connected platform's current terms.

sections.title: How We Share Information
paragraphs: We do not sell your personal information. We may share information with:
list: Cloud infrastructure, hosting, and security providers
Payment processors and billing partners
AI and analytics service providers acting on our instructions (excluding Google Workspace API data, which is not shared with AI/ML providers)
Professional advisers, auditors, and legal authorities where required by law
Affiliates or successors in the event of a merger, acquisition, or asset transfer, subject to this Policy

sections.title: International Data Transfers
paragraphs: Omnider may process and store information in countries other than your own. Where required, we implement appropriate safeguards for cross-border transfers, including contractual protections and security controls consistent with applicable data protection laws.

sections.title: Children's Privacy
paragraphs: The Services are intended for businesses and authorized professionals. They are not directed to children under 16, and we do not knowingly collect personal information from children. If you believe a child has provided us personal information, contact us and we will take appropriate steps to delete it.

sections.title: Changes to This Policy
paragraphs: We may update this Policy from time to time to reflect changes in our Services, legal requirements, or industry practices. The "Last updated" date at the top of this page indicates when the Policy was last revised.

Material changes will be communicated through the Services, by email, or by other reasonable means. Continued use of the Services after the effective date of an updated Policy constitutes acceptance of the revised Policy.

sections.title: Service Description

Omnider Android Application distributed via Google Play
Omnider iOS Application distributed via the Apple App Store
Customer Panel at https://app.omnider.com

Integrations with WhatsApp, Instagram (messaging and comments), Facebook Messenger, Telegram, LINE, Web Chat, email, SMS, phone/voice, Google Business Profile, Google Chat, LinkedIn, and other official platforms Omnider may support in the future

sections.title: Account Responsibility

list: Provide accurate and current registration information
Maintain the confidentiality and security of login credentials and API tokens
Promptly update account details when they change
Notify Omnider immediately of any unauthorized access or suspected security incident
Ensure that each user accesses the Services only through permissions you assign

sections.title: User Obligations
paragraphs: You agree to use the Services lawfully, professionally, and in compliance with these Terms and all applicable laws, regulations, and third-party platform rules.
list: Obtain all required consents, notices, and legal bases before collecting or processing end-customer data
Ensure that messages, campaigns, and automations comply with anti-spam, consumer protection, and sector-specific regulations
Use only contact data you are legally entitled to message or store
Configure AI and automation features responsibly and review outputs before customer delivery where appropriate
Maintain adequate internal policies for your staff using the shared inbox and administrative tools

sections.title: Prohibited Uses
paragraphs: You may not use the Services to engage in unlawful, harmful, abusive, deceptive, or infringing activity. Prohibited uses include, without limitation:
list: Sending spam, unsolicited bulk messages, or fraudulent communications
Harassment, hate speech, threats, exploitation, or distribution of illegal content
Impersonation, phishing, malware distribution, or unauthorized access attempts
Circumventing platform rate limits, API restrictions, or security controls
Reverse engineering, scraping, or reselling the Services except as expressly permitted
Processing special categories of data without lawful basis and appropriate safeguards
Any activity that violates Meta, Google, Apple, Telegram, LINE, or other connected platform policies

subsections.title: Enforcement
paragraphs: We may investigate suspected violations and suspend or terminate access where necessary to protect users, partners, platform integrity, or legal compliance.

sections.title: API Usage
paragraphs: Certain features rely on APIs provided by Omnider or by third-party messaging platforms. Your use of those APIs is subject to both these Terms and the applicable platform's own developer terms.
list: WhatsApp Business Platform — subject to Meta Platform Terms and WhatsApp Business policies
Instagram Business — subject to Meta Platform Terms and Instagram API policies
Facebook Messenger — subject to Meta Platform Terms and Messenger Platform policies
Telegram — subject to Telegram Bot API Terms of Service and applicable Telegram policies
LINE — subject to LINE Developers terms and Messaging API policies

subsections.title: Third-Party Policy Changes
paragraphs: Omnider is not responsible for changes to third-party platform policies, API restrictions, pricing, outages, enforcement actions, or account suspensions imposed by those platforms. You are responsible for monitoring and complying with each connected platform's current terms.

subsections.title: API Limits and Fair Use
paragraphs: You must respect published rate limits, message quotas, webhook requirements, and technical documentation. Excessive or abusive API usage may result in throttling, suspension, or termination of access.

sections.title: Third-Party Services
paragraphs: The Services may interoperate with third-party platforms, payment processors, analytics tools, AI providers, hosting providers, and other external services. Omnider does not control and is not responsible for third-party services, their availability, security practices, or policy changes.

Your relationship with third-party providers is governed by their own terms. Connecting a third-party account to Omnider does not make Omnider responsible for that provider's actions or enforcement decisions.

sections.title: AI Features
paragraphs: Omnider may provide AI-generated suggestions, classifications, summaries, transcriptions, translations, or automated replies. AI outputs are probabilistic and may be incomplete, inaccurate, or inappropriate for specific contexts.
list: You remain solely responsible for messages and decisions sent to end customers
You must review AI-generated content where human judgment is required by law or business policy
You must not rely on AI outputs for medical, legal, financial, or safety-critical advice without qualified human review
Omnider does not guarantee that AI features will be error-free, uninterrupted, or suitable for every use case

sections.title: Google Integrations and AI Services
paragraphs: Omnider may offer Google Workspace integrations (including Google Sheets, Google Drive, and Google Calendar) and separately offer AI-powered messaging features. These are distinct service workflows.
list: Google integrations are used only after you expressly authorize them through Google OAuth
